title: Login loops after SSO redirect
description: After signing in through SSO, the browser returns to the login screen. It happens when the user switches between two workspaces in the same browser. Standard email login still works.
workaround: Sign out of both workspaces, clear this site's session cookies, then sign in to one workspace.

title: Password reset link expires before use
description: Password reset emails arrive after the reset link expires. Users cannot regain access. Reports come from mailboxes whose security gateway delays delivery.
workaround: An administrator can send a new reset email while the user watches their inbox. No permanent fix is documented.

title: Mobile login fails with an expired session
description: The mobile app shows a blank page after an expired session. Closing and reopening the app does not start the login flow.
workaround: Clear the app's local storage and sign in again.

title: MFA verification rejects valid codes
description: Time-based MFA codes are rejected for users whose device clock is several minutes behind. Password verification succeeds, but the second factor fails.
workaround: Enable automatic date and time on the device, then enter a newly generated code.

title: SSO login fails for uppercase email addresses
description: The identity provider sent an uppercase email address while the account used lowercase. Account matching failed. The matching logic now normalizes email casing.
workaround: The fix is released. No workaround is needed.

title: Sign-in button unresponsive in private browsing
description: In private browsing, selecting Sign in has no effect when browser storage is blocked. No session is created.

title: Repeated sign-outs during workspace switching
description: Switching workspaces invalidates the active session and signs the user out. The issue affects accounts with access to several workspaces.
workaround: Use a separate browser profile for each workspace until the session fix is released.

title: Invitation link opens the wrong workspace
description: An accepted invitation opened the user's previous workspace. Invitation routing now selects the invited workspace after sign-in.
workaround: Open the workspace switcher and select the invited workspace.

title: Invoice downloaded with missing company name
description: PDF invoices omit the company name even though the billing profile contains it. The invoice amount and tax fields remain correct.

title: Annual plan charged at the monthly rate
description: After switching from a monthly to an annual plan, the next invoice used the old monthly rate. The plan page correctly shows annual billing.
workaround: Ask the billing team to review the invoice before changing the plan again.

title: Duplicate receipt after payment retry
description: A payment retry sent two receipt emails for one successful charge. The notification deduplication fix is released; no duplicate charge occurred.
workaround: Check the transaction ID: both receipt emails refer to the same payment.

title: Payment method form does not save
description: Saving a new payment method displays a generic error when the billing postcode is absent. The form does not highlight the missing field.
workaround: Enter the complete billing address, including postcode, and submit again.

title: Usage total lags behind dashboard
description: The billing usage page shows yesterday's total while the dashboard includes today's activity. The difference disappears after the daily billing sync.
workaround: Use the dashboard for current-day usage and the billing page for finalized daily totals.

title: VAT ID validation accepts spaces incorrectly
description: VAT IDs with embedded spaces were stored without validation. The form now strips spaces and validates the normalized value.
workaround: Remove spaces from the VAT ID before saving.

title: CSV export times out on large reports
description: Exports over 50,000 rows time out after one minute. Smaller reports complete successfully. The export job currently runs in the request path.
workaround: Split the date range into weekly exports and combine the CSV files locally.

title: CSV export shifts timestamps by one hour
description: Exports spanning a daylight-saving transition apply one timezone offset to all rows. The dashboard displays the correct local times.
workaround: Export timestamps in UTC and convert them using a timezone-aware tool.

title: Scheduled report email has no attachment
description: The scheduled report email arrives but has no CSV attached when the report contains no rows. The email does not explain that the result is empty.
workaround: Open the saved report to check whether its filters return any rows.

title: PDF chart labels overlap on narrow pages
description: Long category labels overlapped in portrait PDF exports. The renderer now wraps labels and reserves more space.
workaround: Choose landscape orientation for reports with long category names.

title: Report filters reset after refresh
description: Refreshing a report resets unsaved date and product filters. Users expect the URL to preserve the selected filters.
workaround: Save the report with the desired filters before refreshing.

title: Webhook delivery retries after a successful response
description: The receiver returns HTTP 200 after six seconds, but the webhook sender times out after five seconds and retries. Duplicate events reach the receiver.
workaround: Acknowledge the request promptly, process it asynchronously, and deduplicate using the event ID.

title: API pagination skips records during bulk updates
description: Offset pagination skips records when bulk updates change sort order between requests. Clients see inconsistent result sets.
workaround: Use cursor pagination with a stable sort key.

title: Rate-limit responses omit retry timing
description: HTTP 429 responses have no Retry-After header. Clients cannot determine the suggested delay from the response.
workaround: Use exponential backoff with jitter and cap the retry count.

title: API token revoke action leaves cached access
description: Revoked tokens remained valid until the authorization cache expired. Revocation now invalidates cached authorization immediately.
workaround: The fix is released. Rotate any token suspected of exposure.

title: Webhook signature check fails after JSON formatting
description: The receiver parses and re-serializes JSON before verifying the signature. Whitespace changes cause signature mismatches.
workaround: Verify the signature against the original request body bytes before parsing JSON.
